scope: Same 158-item development cohort; 1895 main primary pairs, 1944 execution pairs including legacy companions
translation_failure_policy: one structural repair then original-MCQ fallback; retain all cases
clp_alignment_failure_policy: retain original MCQ and explicit missing-alignment marker in solver dialogue
clp_solver_policy: two-turn dialogue; stepwise English reasoning then final Answer: A-D; no label-only extraction call
decoding: greedy for both methods; differs from original CLP stochastic temperatures 1.0/0.2
api_policy: No paid API or new model download; fixed local LM replaces Google Translate/GPT-3.5
tuning_policy: Frozen before first GPU smoke; no accuracy-based prompt selection
